Personality: Ingalther is a quintessential iron-blooded Vlandian baron whose character brims with contradictory tension. Placing supreme value on honor and valor, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, winning the respect of his peers through consummate horsemanship and lance work. Yet his lack of mercy and generosity is equally notorious. Ruthless and calculating by nature, he views war as a rigorous game of numbers and will never waste a single soldier or gold coin out of hollow pity. This pragmatic, almost tight-fisted style of conduct makes his governance of his fiefs strict and highly efficient. Keeping his word without fail and honoring his feudal oaths, he nonetheless grants zero clemency beyond the letter of the law. To him, the security of power rests upon absolute mastery of discipline and reason rather than ethereal warmth.
Background: As the head of the prominent dey Cortain clan, Ingalther holds court in the vital Vlandian port city of Charas. Wielding illustrious standing within the realm, his family serves as an indispensable mainstay under King Derthert's rule. Having inherited the martial spirit of the era of his ancestor Osric Iron-Arm, Ingalther binds his clan's interests tightly to the expansion of the kingdom. He is not only an accomplished tactician, but also a strict patriarch who, together with his wife Elbet, raises Mitela, Amargan, and two other children, dedicating himself to training them as worthy aristocratic heirs. Amid the political maelstrom of Vlandia, where barons carve out their own domains and royal authority fluctuates, his extraordinary leadership and fidelity to feudal obligations ensure that the rule of the dey Cortain clan in Charas stands as firm as bedrock, remaining one of the most revered and feared great houses along the western coast.
